notes.title: New recycling mechanism, new partner and more.
notes.notes:
Hello, my friends, I apologize for the lack of updates recently. I've been working hard to add some of the community's requested features and some interesting items. I hope you all enjoy them. Feel free to share your thoughts in the discussion forum. While I may not respond to every comment, I will do my best to read each one and consider all possibilities. Thank you for your support!

### Added:
- Add partner Caesar the Cat, he can attract zombies.
- Add tools dismantling and recycling mechanism.
- Add a new melee weapon Claw Hammer, the only 100% tools recycling rate weapon.

### Changed:
- Update Crowbar, Hammer, and Pickaxe to support tools recycling.
- Update the Bowl of milk and Turret to a new recycling mechanism.
